plugins.name: kookr-toolkit
plugins.description: Curated skills + subagents shipped with Kookr. 70 skills (TypeScript patterns, async flow control, error handling, DDD, OSS PR workflow, reviewer distillation, independent merge review, communication-quality paper review) + 25 subagents (boundary-critic, design-minimalist, failure-mode-analyst, ambition-amplifier, assumption-archaeologist, task-role specialists repo-cartographer, repro-builder, patch-author, change-verifier, and the product-onboarding pair product-owner + user-test-simulator, and more).
